# Teacher Sara

Teacher Sara is a British English teacher based in Sant Joan d'Alacant (San Juan de Alicante), Alicante, Spain.

## About
- British English teacher
- More than 15 years of English teaching experience in Spain
- Experience teaching in schools in San Sebastián, Pamplona, Madrid and Alicante
- Current teaching area: San Juan de Alicante and nearby Mutxamel

## Services
- English classes for children aged 6–8, 9–11 and 12–14
- Small-group lessons: maximum 4 pupils
- Group price: €12.50 per pupil per lesson when the group is full with 4 pupils
- Individual lessons: €25 per class
- School English support: homework, tasks and projects
- Speaking, reading, writing, grammar and vocabulary practice
- Cambridge English preparation for school-age learners and teenagers

## Timetable
- Monday–Thursday afternoons
- 16:30–17:30: 6–8 years
- 17:30–18:30: 9–11 years
- 18:30–19:30: 12–14 years
- Groups open as pupils enrol; actual availability is confirmed directly

## Location and privacy
- San Juan de Alicante / Sant Joan d'Alacant
- Serves families in Mutxamel
- Exact home address is not published publicly
